label: Test whether a particular mode draws on its bearer's received esse
summary: In docs/notes/actuality-esse-research.md §9, performer substitution fixes attribution. The response to changes in the actual string's condition supports using it as a contributor at the instrument level. Its fundamental priority over a process that realizes both string and motion is open. This can be a dependence of a way the subject is, without a further subsisting recipient. Secondary agency can explain specificity. Independence from one giver adds a brute fact only if the positive determination itself is left primitive relative to the whole proposed basis. An organized process that grounds both bearer and episode challenges the direction of explanation. In the joint-contribution interpretation, compare deleting the same recipient's esse support with deleting its particular skill record. The selective test can fail even with every original respect actual and supplied. The joint interpretation retains inherited dependence alongside the populated secondary-only causal countermodel to universal transfer. Application of the support records to real constitution and productive efficacy is open. With an unseeded bearer-esse, deleting every record producing it provides an exact test of all record cuts. A contributor at the last group or a mediated path through an identified region supplies a sufficient positive account. Even in the enabler row the secondary producer's esse draws on the universal source. The certificate separates causal attribution from inherited supply and does not exhibit a particular mode supplied independently of the universal source. Priority 4 tests the move from each mode being dispensable to the whole family being dispensable. At every setting a two-regime process model satisfies 7067553d; each regime can lapse while the process persists, but all regimes cannot lapse together while it persists. The checked control and impeller/process comparison in the linked note favor same-bearer existential import while leaving bearer-first constitution and the efficient authorship of changes as separate questions. Curation (#2103, 2026-11-27, PR #2156): no derivation from the cut-inheritance statement ca58266a to a root-path premise is warranted. ca58266a and the single-deletion equivalence 3651b6e2 now carry connection plans to 2f6b9eff naming the missing calibration bridge (inherited esse cuts plus a giver's represented contribution to CausesIn c x r), and the populated joint control tests b26c10a0: cut inheritance with 791fa216 and the transfer background holds there while universal transfer fails.
blocker: The existential contribution of the same bearer to this mode neither identifies a separate act of esse for the mode nor warrants productive responsibility of the bearer’s giver for each execution. To argue for one giver’s indispensability through this inheritance result, withdrawing that giver’s supply must deprive the bearer of esse despite the available alternatives. Reopen the stronger conclusion on an independently warranted execution-level bridge that applies before naming the source as God.
